rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The version of an author's original scholarly work, such as a research paper or a review, re-submitted for publication after revision by the author in the light of comments from reviewers.
rdf:Description.skos:note: Note: For the version before peer review, use fabio:Preprint. For the final published version, use fabio:DefinitiveVersion.
rdf:Description.rdfs:label: postprint
